notes.title: Spammerina has Released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/fd16d3efae4a26e4c32b8b4bbe4810a5bf6dbc3f.png

It's time to conquer the Dark Continent!
Join Spammerina as she blasts her way to the Great Beasts and discovers the secrets of the Dark Continent

It's been a great challenge creating Spammerina, but we hope you enjoy joining her on her adventure
Good Luck

notes.title: Devlog: Manual Pages + Development
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/1950bdba7e3b12992adc57b0a0bb7e148612540d.png

Devlog - 2024/7/24

Spammerina is now closer than ever to its release! We are now adding in the last features, balancing the difficulty, and playtesting again and again and again and...

See you when Spammerina releases in early August!

notes.title: Devlog: Bringing it all Together!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/9375404dd8ab5f9aa47a90031e5bc7310e3a437b.png

Devlog - 2024/7/18

The assets have been selected, the map created.
Now we are adding all the parts together: monsters, their attacks, player spells, relics... The list goes on!
Getting closer and closer to release!

notes.title: Devlog: Creating Loot and Upgrades
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/8478e0fb502938b5da5014700688724f73573427.png

Devlog - 2024/7/16

How much loot should the player get? Which materials upgrade which spells?
Currently planning out the loot for the adventure! Monsters should always drop some kind of reward for a brave witch!

notes.title: Devlog: Adding Spell Animations
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/69c6b810b4772d260e0433aab2710802077a2daa.png

Devlog - 2024/7/15

Adding Spell Animations to Spammerina!
Each spell will have it's own specific animation to be used when blasting beasts. We are also adding the attack animations for the mobs during this time.

notes.title: Spammerina Manual in the works
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088214/b75ad424b584ed0e2247eb89240053f659c47335.png

Game Manual Incoming!
Currently working on the Spammerina Game Manual
We're emulating a retro strategy guide, inspired by the many fake games being created!
We look forward to releasing the complete manual soon
